'''Barra''' was a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] who served in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] military during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was stationed at [[Wardpost Hurne]] in the [[Glarus Valley]] where she met a Republic spacer who was sent by Captain [[Cahill]].
